title: Possibilities
author: Wisława Szymborska
who: Wisława Szymborska (1923 to 2012) was a Polish poet and essayist who received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1996. She wrote in Polish; English readers usually meet her through translation, so the exact wording depends on the translator.
why: The reason this poem was written is not known to me, and I will not guess. What is documented is that Szymborska wrote short, plain-spoken poems built around small preferences and large questions.
notice: Notice how the poem is built as a list of things the speaker prefers, and how ordinary the items are. Watch for the moment the list stops being a list of tastes and starts being a way of describing a whole person. Notice too what the repeated shape does to your own thoughts: you start making your own list.
prompts: Write three things you prefer, in plain words. What do they say about you that a résumé would not?
Which of your preferences would you defend, and which would you quietly let go of?
